note: Two-hop mapping from one scheme to another through org, as Proskomma's do_cv does it: forward through the source scheme's table, then each pivot verse back through the target's reversed table. Bare names are tC4's JSON schemes; vrs:proskomma/<name> are Proskomma's own .vrs copies. Domain: every verse 0..=last+1 of every chapter in the source scheme's verse counts (`inputs` gives the count per pair). Results other than the input itself, as 'B c:v=hop[;hop...]' (one reverse hop per pivot verse) or the run form 'B c:v1..v2=B c:w'. Every input was also run through Proskomma's mappedCv query on generated docSets (2106839 queries), which agreed once its reading of documents is accounted for (see generate.mjs).
